name: Dial-Up
blurb: A screeching speed freak on a janky bike.

look.description: A wiry kid in a beige-plastic helmet with a coiled phone cord for a chin strap, goggles taped on. Rides a rattling bike held together with zip ties and a modem on the tail.

meta.notes: Regular. M4 rivals-1 (built early): a weaver, fast and erratic, swerves across the road rather than inside his lane, dodges through oncoming traffic, kicks more than he punches, low health. He hunts nobody unless he holds a grudge or his rival is near. Rivalry: Chad Speedwell, old internet against new internet. The modem-handshake screech on approach is an audio follow-up. Approved line: "You've got mail. It's my boot."
